name: fuel_co2_per_km
title: CO2 emissions from fuel consumption (TP7 exercise 3)
summary: Teaching exercise: CO2 mass emitted per kilometre from a fuel consumption in L/100 km, by complete combustion of a hydrocarbon CmHn. The fuel is a chemical formula, a density and a volume consumption, for diesel or gasoline.

origin.course: ULiège MCI, TP7, exercise 3 (CO2 emissions from fuel consumption).
